XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadically the cabin fans run only at maximum speed or turn off
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: CLIMATE | RESISTANCE | FANS | FAN | PASSENGER COMPARTMENT | AIR CONDITIONING | AIR | CONDITIONED | HEATING | VENTILATION | WORK | GO | AIR CONDITIONING | 01273 | 04F9 | AUTOMATIC | |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars fitted with automatic climate control

  • System: Climate control

  • Component: Air conditioning/heating cabin fan resistor

  • Fault: The vehicle’s cabin fans (air conditioning/heating) are not operating.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: 01273 | 04F9 (Fresh air fan circuit – Fault)

  • Cause: Faulty cabin fan resistor

• Action: Check that the cabin fan heater is working correctly; replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The heater element in question is accessible from the passenger compartment; this requires removal of the glove box, a plastic panel beneath the glove box and the cabin air filter
